title: Reaction-Diffusion Processes with Surface Autocatalysis
summary: Autocatalytic processes underlie diverse systems in which replication is triggered at interfaces, including heterogeneous catalysis on solid substrates, enzyme activity at membranes, viral infections, biofilm growth, and spatially structured ecosystems. In a typical scenario, particles move in a bulk medium and interact with surface regions, where they may either disappear or reproduce through branching, splitting or fission.
